create_PEFTAdapterEMACallback: create a PEFT adapter EMA callback that maintains an exponential moving average of adapter weights for self-distillation teacher models
initialize_teacher_adapter: initialize a zero-weighted PEFT teacher adapter from the student adapter configuration and state dict
update_teacher_weights: update teacher adapter shadow weights via exponential moving average at each training step end
apply_teacher_weights: apply EMA shadow weights to the teacher PEFT adapter so it can be used as a distillation target
get_student_state_dict: get the student PEFT adapter state dict with proper accelerator unwrapping for distributed training
